action_items: No backend API-bearing criteria in this matrix; the eight product image galleries live entirely in frontend/src/data/catalog.ts as static local data, so no new backend test file was needed.

checks.criterion: Every House Collection title is paired with imagery relevant to its named jewelry type and material
checks.name: collection-imagery-loads-per-product
checks.evidence: All 8 product card main images loaded (naturalWidth=1200) with alt text matching each product's type/material, e.g. moonlit-pearl-collar alt='Luminous pearl necklace on ivory silk, view 1', thewa-sun-pendant alt='Warm gold pendant...', silver-tide-cuff alt='Modern silver cuff bracelet...'.

checks.criterion: Every House Collection product has three working card images
checks.name: product-card-three-images-cycle
checks.evidence: For all 8 products: exactly 3 position dots rendered, each dot click loaded a distinct image (naturalWidth>0, 3 unique srcs), next/previous arrows changed and restored the image, and no product-detail-modal opened from any of these controls.

checks.name: product-text-content-unchanged
checks.evidence: All 8 product names, materials, and formatted INR prices (e.g. Moonlit Pearl Collar/Pearls/14,800 ... Golden Hour Chain/Champagne Gold/13,400) verified present on their respective product-id-keyed testids.

checks.criterion: Product detail modal provides a complete three-image gallery
checks.name: product-detail-three-image-gallery
checks.evidence: Opened Silver Tide Cuff detail: 3 thumbnails rendered; image counter progressed 1/3 -> 2/3 (thumbnail) -> 3/3 (next arrow, loaded naturalWidth>0) -> 2/3 (previous) -> 1/3 (thumbnail 1) with main image src changing/returning correctly each step.

checks.criterion: Card and detail controls remain usable without accidental navigation
checks.name: card-controls-no-accidental-navigation
checks.evidence: Thewa Sun Pendant: card next/previous arrows and dot 2 click did not open product-detail-modal; clicking the card image opened the modal with matching name; modal next-button changed image while staying open; close button closed it.

checks.criterion: Browse-to-cart flow still works after gallery changes
checks.name: browse-card-to-cart-flow
checks.evidence: Cycled Gulabi Bloom Ring card images (next arrow + dot 3, no modal opened), opened detail, clicked Add to bag -> cart-drawer auto-opened with navbar-cart-count=1 and cart-item-name-gulabi-bloom-ring='Gulabi Bloom Ring'.

checks.criterion: Product galleries are usable on mobile
checks.name: mobile-product-gallery-usability
checks.evidence: At 390x844: River Pearl Drop card next-arrow and dot changed image without opening the modal; opening details showed 3 thumbnails, close button, name and description visible; thumbnail 2 click updated main image; close button closed the modal.
